name: Time To Die
overview: Scripture reveals that the time of death is sovereignly determined by God, who has set the bounds of human life that cannot be exceeded (Job 14:5). While the exact timing is hidden from us, resting in God's control (Acts 1:7), believers are assured that death is not the end but a transition to eternal life through faith in Christ (John 3:16). The death of God's saints is precious in His sight (Psalms 116:15), and after death comes the judgment (Hebrews 9:27), underscoring the eternal significance of how we live in the time allotted to us (Ecclesiastes 3:1).
